intro.h2: Custom Cabinets in Polson, Built One Piece at a Time
paragraphs: Jackson Woodworks is a cabinet maker in Polson, Montana, building custom cabinets and woodwork for local homes. Owner Bob Jackson does the work himself, from tall raised-panel cabinets and built-in desks to the small details that make a kitchen work better day to day.

Customers talk about Bob as much as the wood. Carl R. calls him an artist and a craftsman who takes the time to do it right. Teri W. points out that he is just as happy with a couple of small repair jobs as with larger, beautiful pieces, and Patricia J. says repairs are quick, friendly and not a lot of money.

items.name: Custom cabinetry and built-ins
items.blurb: Cabinets built to fit the room rather than chosen from a catalog. The example here pairs a tall raised-panel cabinet with open upper shelves and a wraparound built-in desk with file drawers, all in a warm stained wood with crown on top.

image.alt: Stained wood built-in office with a tall two-door cabinet, upper shelves and an L-shaped desk with drawers

items.name: Kitchen woodwork and cutting boards
items.blurb: Small pieces that change how a kitchen works. Bob made a pair of fitted hardwood cutting boards that sit over a gas cooktop on a granite island, turning the burners into extra prep space when they are not in use.

image.alt: Two fitted hardwood cutting boards covering a stainless gas cooktop on a granite island with a mosaic tile backsplash

items.name: Furniture, benches and stairs
items.blurb: Handmade furniture and finish carpentry. The Jackson Woodworks banner shows a solid wood bench with a curved slatted back, a wood staircase with railings in a vaulted room, and a wood kitchen with an island, all examples of the larger work Bob takes on.

image.alt: Jackson Wood Works banner with photos of a wood staircase, a slatted wood bench and a wood kitchen

items.name: Repairs and small jobs
items.blurb: Not every job needs to be big. Reviewers have brought Bob a couple of small repair jobs and other things to fix, and say he finished quickly, did a wonderful job and kept the cost low. Call him before you replace something that might be saved.

items.title: A craftsman who takes his time
items.text: Carl R. calls Bob an artist and a craftsman, and says that if you need a quality custom project, he takes the time to do it right.

items.title: No job too small
items.text: Teri W. had a couple of small repair jobs and recommends Bob for little jobs too, not just the larger, beautiful pieces he is known for.

items.title: Fair prices, fast repairs
items.text: Patricia J. describes the shop as friendly and inexpensive, and says you will get your things repaired quickly for not a lot of hassle or money.

items.title: Polite and professional
items.text: Reviewers call Bob very polite and professional, and a good man to boot. He also replies to his reviews himself and makes sure customers are satisfied.

about.text: Jackson Woodworks is Bob Jackson's shop on Courville Trail in Polson, Montana. Bob is a cabinet maker who builds custom cabinets, built-ins and furniture, and his customers describe him as an artist and a craftsman. The shop's hand-carved sign, burned wood with raised letters, says a lot about how he works: by hand and with care. Alongside the larger custom pieces, Bob takes on small repair jobs, and reviewers say he finishes them quickly and does a wonderful job. He replies to his reviews in person.

image.alt: Hand-carved Jackson Woodworks sign on a workbench with hand planes, a chisel and a carpenter's pencil in wood shavings

process.h2: How a Custom Piece Comes Together

steps.title: Call the shop
steps.text: Call (406) 600-4443 any day between 8 AM and 5 PM and describe the piece, the room or the repair.

steps.title: Look and measure
steps.text: Bob looks at the space or the item, takes measurements and talks through wood, finish and how you will use it.

steps.title: Build in the shop
steps.text: The piece is built in the Polson shop. As one reviewer put it, he takes the time to do it right.

steps.title: Install or pick up
steps.text: Built-ins are installed in your home, and repairs or furniture are ready for you to collect when finished.

items.name: Carl R.
items.text: Bob Jackson is an artist and a craftsman and a good man to boot!  Highly recommend if you need a quality custom project he takes the time to do it right.

items.name: Teri W.
items.text: Bob is very polite and professional. I had a couple of small repair jobs that he completed quickly. He did a wonderful job on both of them. I would recommend him for those little jobs, too, not just the larger, beautiful work you can see on his website.

items.name: Patricia J.
items.text: This place is friendly, inexpensive and does quality work.  I highly recommend them.  You’ll get your stuff repaired quickly for not a lot of hassle or money.

service_area.text: Jackson Woodworks is based at 34598 Courville Trail in Polson, Montana. Custom cabinets and built-ins are made in the shop and fitted in your home, and smaller repairs can be brought in. If you live in or around Polson and have a project or a piece that needs fixing, give Bob a call to check his schedule and talk it through.

items.q: Do you only build large custom projects?
items.a: No. Bob builds custom cabinets, built-ins and furniture, but he also takes on small repair jobs. One customer had a couple of small repairs done quickly and recommends him for little jobs too. Another says you will get your things repaired quickly for not a lot of hassle or money.

items.q: What kind of cabinets do you make?
items.a: Custom cabinets made to fit the room, like the stained wood office built-in with a tall raised-panel cabinet, open shelves and a wraparound desk shown above. Bob also makes kitchen pieces such as fitted cutting boards. Call to talk about the room, wood and finish you have in mind.

Jackson Woodworks lists its hours as 8 AM to 5 PM every day of the week, Sunday through Saturday. Bob may be in the middle of a build, so if he does not pick up, leave a message with your name, number and a short description of the project.

The shop is at 34598 Courville Trail, Polson, MT 59860. Custom cabinets and built-ins are made there and installed at your home. Call (406) 600-4443 before stopping by so Bob can make sure he is at the shop and has time to look at your piece.

items.q: How long does a custom project take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the piece and what else is in the shop. Customers say Bob takes the time to do it right on custom work, and finishes small repairs quickly. He will give you a realistic idea of timing when he has seen the job and talked through the details.

final_cta.text: Call Bob at the Polson shop about custom cabinets, a built-in or a repair.
